findings.detail: 9p mount with source D:\ but aname=drvfs;path=C:\ passes. Require drvfs path metadata agreement with bound drive; reject missing/duplicate/inconsistent path metadata.

An output directory on a tmpfs mount outside /mnt passes and its statfs capacity is counted as Ubuntu guest capacity. Verify output covering mount belongs to the root ext4 device; reject tmpfs, other devices and overmounts before measurement.

12GiB host and8GiB guest thresholds preserved with additional growth bytes. Provenance hash matches correction document. Missing/wrong host mount, canonical-path mismatch and measurement failures do not fall back to C: or guest.

Registry-to-VHDX mapping is coordinating-agent evidence bound by hash, not independently refreshed by the Linux guard. Freeze must bind guard, metadata and provenance. Current D: capacity has not been independently measured in this synthetic review.
